senses.gloss: (denom. of נְאוּם, as נָאַם, Jer. XXIII, 31) to speak, say.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:10">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>שנָם</he>, v. <cite ref="L00570"><he>לְמוּאֵל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 4:14">Tosef. Ohol. IV, 14</cite> <he>נם לי הן</he> said he to me, Yes.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 4:14">Ib.</cite> <he>נַמְתִּי</he> said I; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="N00369"><he>נוֹמֶה</he></cite> (fr. <cite ref="N00856"><he>נמה</he></cite>), fr. which (as in Chald.) <he>נוֹמֵיתִי</he>, <he>נוֹמִינוּ</he> &c.
Yeb. XVI, 7 (122ᵃ) ונומיתי לו (Y. ed. ונִימֵּיתִי, Pi.) and I said to him.
<cite ref="Yevamot 122a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>נוֹמֵית</he> Bab. ed. (Y. ed. <he>נוֹמַת</he>; Mish. <cite ref="A02065"><he>אמרה</he></cite>) said she.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 6:7">Gitt. VI, 7</cite> <he>נומינו לשליח</he> (Ar. <he>נִמִּינוּ</he>) we said to the messenger; a. e.—Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᶜ top <he>ונומה לי</he> (ed. Krot. <he>ונִימָּה</he>); Y. Naz. II, end, 51ᶜ <cite ref="N00671"><he>נִימָּא</he></cite> (fr. <cite ref="N00856"><he>נמא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 4:7">Tosef. Naz. IV, 7</cite> <cite ref="N00855"><he>נם</he></cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 22">Sifré Num. 22</cite> <cite ref="N00022"><he>נָאַם</he></cite>, <he>נָאַמְתִּי</he>.—

<cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 2:8">Treat. Der. Er. ch. II</cite> <he>המְנַמִּין והמפפין בידיהם</he> who make motions with their hands when speaking.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 5:12">Tosef. Ohol. V, 12</cite> <he>נמיתי</he> ed. Zuck., oth. ed. <he>נמתי</he>, read: <he>נעניתי</he>, v. <cite ref="P00972"><he>עָנָה</he> II</cite>.]
